params.name: entityType
params.description: Indicates whether to retrieve credentialing requests for providers or facilities. Defaults to `Providers`.

params.name: currentEventStatus
params.description: If set, the items will be filtered by the specified current event status.

params.name: providerCredentialingStatus
params.description: If set, the items will be filtered by the specified provider credentialing status. Has no effect when querying facilities.

params.name: priority
params.description: If set, the items will be filtered by the specified priority.

params.name: ownerId
params.description: If set, the items will be filtered by the specified owner.

params.name: includeUnassigned
params.description: If set, the items will include credentialing requests that are not assigned to any specified owner. Intended to be used together with `ownerId`.

params.name: credentialingRequestType
params.description: If set, the items will be filtered by the specified credentialing request type.

params.name: entityId
params.description: If set, the items will be filtered by the specified entity identifier (`providerId` or `facilityId`).

params.name: entityName
params.description: If set, the items will be filtered by the specified entity name (provider name/alias or facility name).

params.name: entityNpi
params.description: If set, the items will be filtered by the specified entity NPI number.

params.name: entityDeactivated
params.description: If set, the items will be filtered by the specified entity deactivated status.

params.name: facilitySpecialtyId
params.description: If set, the items will be filtered by the specified specialty.

params.name: providerId
params.description: See `entityId`.

params.name: providerName
params.description: See `entityName`.

params.name: providerNpi
params.description: See `entityNpi`.

params.name: providerDeactivated
params.description: See `entityDeactivated`.

params.name: sortedBy
params.description: The property by which the returned data will be sorted.

params.name: sort
params.description: If set, the properties and directions the returned data will be sorted by.

params.name: offset
params.description: The offset for the page to start.

params.name: cursor
params.description: The cursor to render the page requested. To load the first page send an empty cursor, then the system will generate the cursors to go to the next and/or previous pages automatically.

params.name: count
params.description: The number of items to include in a single page.

params.name: sortDirection
params.description: The direction the returned data will be sorted by.
